name: Shion
source:
The protagonist of the Pure Love Route.
Shion is a straightforward and simple-minded young man.
After he didn’t manifest any magical power during his coming of age, his parents decided to leave him in the care of a family that specializes in magical research.
Shion boasts incredible physical fitness even without being able to use his magical power.
He has feelings for Rui, who always takes care of his health and often pampers him.
